verdict.rationale: Polar's docs say it serves versioned OpenAPI 3.1.0 specs (2026-04.openapi.json and 2026-10.openapi.json, "Polar HTTP and Webhooks API") directly from the docs site, which is a downloadable machine-readable spec. The probe 404s were on guessed root paths (polar.sh/openapi.json and similar), not the docs-site paths, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: a hands-on probe confirming the docs-site spec files download, the full documented download URL, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: serves versioned OpenAPI specs straight from the docs site (2026-04.openapi.json and 2026-10.openapi.json, OpenAPI 3.1.0 — "Polar HTTP and Webhooks API")
